description: This line plot illustrates the performance of five different trajectory prediction methods—TrajICL, Head Tuning, FT, LoRA 16, and LoRA 64—as a function of a varying "Ratio" parameter, with performance measured by the minimum FDE20 metric (minFDE20, in units of meters). The x-axis, labeled "Ratio," spans from 0 to 1.0 in a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled "minFDE20 (m)", ranges from 0.8 to 1.3 in a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The TrajICL method is represented by a blue line with circular markers and a solid line, starting at approximately 0.90 and ending near 0.87. The Head Tuning method is shown as an orange line with circular markers and a solid line, beginning at approximately 1.31 and decreasing to about 1.10. The FT method is depicted as a green line with circular markers and a solid line, starting at approximately 1.10 and declining to about 0.78. The LoRA 16 method is represented by a red line with circular markers and a solid line, beginning at approximately 1.22 and decreasing to about 0.93. The LoRA 64 method is shown as a purple line with circular markers and a solid line, starting at approximately 1.22 and decreasing to about 0.93. All lines show a general downward trend as the Ratio increases from 0 to 1.0, with the FT method showing the steepest decline and the TrajICL method showing the most stable performance.
